\begin{example} \end{example}[Simplicial homology of $\mathbb {RP}^2$] ↗ lem:boundary-composition-zero 1. ch2:2.4\group Singular Homology

For the two-vertex, three-edge, two-triangle structure on $\mathbb {RP}^2$, $\operatorname {Im}\partial _1=\langle w-v\rangle $, $\partial _2U=-a+b+c$, and $\partial _2L=a-b+c$. Therefore \[ H_0^\Delta (\mathbb {RP}^2)\cong \mathbb {Z},\qquad H_1^\Delta (\mathbb {RP}^2)\cong \mathbb {Z}_2,\qquad H_2^\Delta (\mathbb {RP}^2)=0. \] \end{example}
